sourceCaveats.detail: One construction-code temperature-rise provision contains an inconsistent parenthetical Celsius conversion. Key uses the operative imperial temperature rise and maximum, without requiring replication of the negative Celsius text. The canonical bytes remain untouched.

One fire preparedness scenario tests enacted plan classification. Transition/implementation provisions and rule-dependent operational details remain in the source packet; classification does not establish an unverified implementing-rule effective date or complete departmental approval.

Referenced ASHRAE/NFPA/UL/ASTM standards, Electrical Code requirements and agency layout rules are not silently filled from general model memory. The tested questions distinguish the available enacted baseline from genuinely needed product, engineering or rule details.

A draft inventory question was replaced before freezing after full-source review showed the retained empty-container counting clause names different quantity subsections than the current outdoor limit. No absolute outdoor counting answer is assumed from that stale cross-reference.

Complete canonical HTML retains linked figure references. Quantitative protection geometry or figure-only clearances are not adjudicated from unseen images; the appliance question tests enacted manufacturer-permission/service-access boundaries.
